name: Hashibami Iro no Hitomi no Naka wa
original_name: はしばみ色の瞳の中は
source:
Deep in the woods, a residence stood still...
I was of poor health, so while waiting for my parents to return from work,
I led the most peaceful of lives.
I got to eat delicious food, spend time with my trusty servant;
there truly was not a single inconvenience.
I made some mistakes, but even so, this happiness was sure to continue.
That's what I thought. Until that fateful day...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6613]Freem![/url]]
translation:
森林深处，静静伫立着一座宅邸……

我身体不好，父母下班回来之前，一直过着平静的生活。
我吃得到美味的食物，还有可靠的仆人陪伴；
生活中似乎没有任何不便。
虽然我也犯过一些错，但这样的幸福一定会延续下去。

我曾这么想。直到那个命运般的日子……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6613]Freem![/url]]
